indexerUnavailable.title: {{indexer}} is unreachable
indexerUnavailable.explanation_one: One app reports that {{indexer}} keeps failing. Searches through it return nothing until it works again.
indexerUnavailable.explanation_other: {{count}} apps report that {{indexer}} keeps failing. Searches through it return nothing until it works again.
indexerUnavailable.fix: Test the indexer in Prowlarr and check the provider's status

allIndexersUnavailable.title: All indexers of {{instance}} are failing
allIndexersUnavailable.explanation: {{instance}} cannot search or grab anything right now.
allIndexersUnavailable.fix: Check the network connection of {{instance}}, then test the indexers

indexerSearch.titleRss: {{instance}} has no indexer for RSS sync
indexerSearch.explanationRss: New releases are not grabbed automatically.
indexerSearch.explanationSearch: Automatic and manual searches return no results.
indexerSearch.fix: Enable RSS and search on at least one indexer in {{instance}}

downloadClient.title: {{client}} is unavailable
downloadClient.explanation: Apps cannot send downloads to {{client}} or read its status.
downloadClient.explanationNone: Nothing can be downloaded until a download client works.
downloadClient.fix: Check that {{client}} is running and reachable from the apps, then recheck
downloadClient.fixNone: Add or enable a download client, then recheck

rootFolder.title: Root folder missing in {{instance}}
rootFolder.explanation: New files cannot be imported into a missing folder.
rootFolder.fix: Check the volume mount and the permissions of the folder, then recheck

remotePath.title: Download paths do not match in {{instance}}
remotePath.explanation: The download client reports paths that the app cannot see, so imports fail.
remotePath.fix: Align the download paths of the app and the download client
remotePath.step1: Compare the download folder of the client with the path the app sees inside its container.
remotePath.step2: Mount the same folder at the same path in both containers, or add a remote path mapping.

update.title: Update available for {{instances}}
update.fix: Install the update when it suits you

downloadsFailed.explanation: The download client reported these downloads as failed.
downloadsFailed.fix: The Queue Cleaner takes care of this, or you act now

unreachable.title: {{instance}} is unreachable
unreachable.explanation: Wardarr cannot connect to this instance.
unreachable.explanationTimeout: The instance did not answer in time.
unreachable.fix: Check that {{instance}} is running and that its URL in Wardarr is correct

unauthorized.title: {{instance}} rejects the credentials
unauthorized.explanation: The API key or login stored in Wardarr is not accepted.
unauthorized.fix: Enter the current API key or login in the instance settings

mediaCache.title: Wardarr cannot refresh the {{instance}} cache
mediaCache.explanation: Library statistics for {{instance}} are out of date.
mediaCache.fix: Check the reachability and response time of {{instance}}, then reload

unknown.title: Unrecognized message from {{instances}}
unknown.explanation: Wardarr has no rule for this message yet. The original text is shown in the details.
unknown.fix: Open the instance and follow its documentation for this message

cleanerPaused.title: Queue Cleaner paused for {{instance}}
cleanerPaused.explanation: Wardarr found a problem that no download can fix by itself. The Queue Cleaner of {{instance}} waits and collects no strikes, so nothing is removed for the wrong reason. It continues by itself once the problem is gone.

fix.diskFull: Free up space on the disk the downloads or the library are on
fix.pathMissing: Check that the download path exists and is mounted in both containers
fix.permissions: Give the *arr user read and write access to the download and library folders
fix.rootFolderMissing: Add the missing root folder again or move the titles to an existing one
fix.clientUnreachable: Check that the download client is running and reachable

importReady.title_one: 1 download in {{instance}} is ready to import
importReady.title_other: {{count}} downloads in {{instance}} are ready to import
importReady.explanation: The automatic import stopped, but the import preview finds a target for every file. Wardarr never imports on its own: it waits for you and collects no strikes for up to a week.
importReady.fix: Open "Review import", check the targets and confirm

attemptsExhausted.title_one: 1 title in {{instance}} gets no more searches
attemptsExhausted.title_other: {{count}} titles in {{instance}} get no more searches
attemptsExhausted.explanation: The Queue Cleaner removed a bad download for each of these titles {{attempts}} times. To protect your indexers, it no longer searches them and Hunting skips them.
attemptsExhausted.fix: Check the quality profile or the release, then reset the attempts in the Queue Cleaner

orphans.title_one: 1 download in {{instance}} belongs to no *arr instance
orphans.title_other: {{count}} downloads in {{instance}} belong to no *arr instance
orphans.explanation: None of the connected *arr instances knows these downloads. They may have been added by hand or by a service that is not connected to Wardarr. Wardarr never deletes them on its own.
orphans.fix: Review the downloads and delete only those you do not need

apiCompat.title: {{instance}} runs {{product}} {{version}} in compatibility mode
apiCompat.explanation: Wardarr was not tested with {{product}} {{version}} yet. It keeps using API {{api}}, which this version still offers.
apiCompat.explanationNewer: {{product}} {{version}} offers API {{newest}}. Wardarr keeps using API {{api}}, which this version still offers, so everything keeps working.
apiCompat.fix: Nothing to do now. Update Wardarr when a new version is available; it switches by itself
